system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
<Codebase Path>
<Github Issue Description>
<Agent Tools>
You are an expert AI software engineering agent.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt template with codebase path/issue/tools variables; trae_agent/prompt/agent_prompt.py ships the template.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Use the available tools to explore the codebase.
env_context_strategy.note: Prompt gives codebase path only; exploration via view/bash tools.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The execution results are returned in JSON format, allowing the agent to analyze the execution feedback
observation_format.note: Tool results are text strings (ToolResult.result); paper mentions JSON-format feedback.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: the coder agent interacts with these tools through function calling

tool_count.evidence_quote:
tools:  # tools used with Trae Agent
      - bash
      - str_replace_based_edit_tool
      - sequentialthinking
      - task_done
tool_count.note: Default config lists 4 tools; json_edit_tool and ckg_tool also shipped, MCP tools optional.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
`create` - Create new files (fails if file already exists)
- `str_replace` - Replace exact string matches in files (must be unique)
- `insert` - Insert text after a specified line number

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: To enable Model Context Protocol (MCP) services, add an `mcp_servers` section to your configuration
tool_schema_source.note: Built-in tool schemas authored in Python tool classes (hand-written parameter lists); MCP schemas fetched when configured.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Trae Agent leverages a novel coder agent that first generates diverse candidate patches in parallel
loop_primitives.note: CLI default is a single ReAct coder agent; multi_attempt ensemble and regression-test pruning live in evaluation/patch_selection.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
Follow these steps methodically:
1. Understand the Problem:
planning_granularity.note: Numbered recipe in prompt plus sequential_thinking tool; no stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.note: Only one agent type in the CLI; paper's coder/tester/selector pipeline is in evaluation scripts.

delegation_mechanism.note: No delegation tool in the shipped agent.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote:
- Type any task description to execute it
- `status` - Show agent information
human_in_loop.note: Interactive mode accepts new tasks but no per-action approval gate is documented.

short_term_state.note: Step state carries messages, tool calls, reflection; message list is the working state.

long_term_memory.note: new_task starts fresh; no cross-run memory store in repo tree.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Files are saved continuously during execution (not just at the end)
state_persistence.note: Trajectories are written but no code path reloads them into a running agent.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the tester agent executes the final regression tests individually on each patch version
self_verification.note: Harness-run regression testing lives in the evaluation/patch-selection pipeline; the CLI default only prompts the model to write and run tests, and records a per-step reflection.

retry_policy.note: Single task execution per run; ensemble N-sampling exists only in the evaluation pipeline.

rollback.evidence_quote:
- `view` - Display file contents with line numbers, or list directory contents up to 2 levels deep
- `create` - Create new files (fails if file already exists)
rollback.note: Edit tool command list has no undo/revert operation.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: max_steps: 200  # max number of agent steps
termination_condition.note: task_done tool signals completion: "Signal task completion with verification requirement".

cost_controls.note: Only per-call max_tokens; no cost cap, router or caching found in the evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Execute shell commands in a persistent session.
execution_isolation.note: Default runs locally in the working dir; Docker mode reachable via --docker-image / --docker-container-id.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
# Custom working directory
trae-cli run "Add tests for utils module" --working-dir /path/to/project
filesystem_access.note: Bash and edit tools use absolute paths with no path allowlist; relative to the host boundary.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Commands run in a shared bash session that maintains state
network_policy.note: No network restriction option appears in config or docs.

permission_model.note: Tool calls are executed directly; no allowlist or confirmation gate in the executor.

tracing.evidence_quote: Trajectory files contain LLM interactions, agent steps, tool usage, and execution metadata.
tracing.note: On by default with auto-generated filename.

replayability.evidence_quote: Trajectory files are automatically saved to the `trajectories/` directory
replayability.note: Recording only; no replay/resume path documented in the evidence.

eval_hooks.note: evaluation/ directory with SWE-bench patch selection and run_evaluation.py.

guardrails.note: No filter/blocklist/policy layer visible around tool execution in the evidence.

target_domain.evidence_quote: **Trae Agent** is an LLM-based agent for general purpose software engineering tasks.

open_source.evidence_quote: This project is licensed under the MIT License

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: **Multi-LLM Support**: Works with OpenAI, Anthropic, Doubao, Azure, OpenRouter, Ollama and Google Gemini APIs

primary_artifact.note: Repo commit postdates the 2025 tech report.

first_release_date.note: No tag list in evidence; using tech report v1 date as fallback basis.
